# CSPNeXt

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/cspnext.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/cspnext.py) ·
**Architectures:** 5 · **Pretrained weights:** 5 (0 with ImageNet-1k results)

The CSPNeXt backbone of the RTMDet real-time object detector (CSP blocks with 5x5 depthwise convolutions), with
ImageNet-1k classification weights converted from the OpenMMLab checkpoints.

## Papers

* [RTMDet: An Empirical Study of Designing Real-Time Object Detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.07784)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('cspnext_l.rsb_a1_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`CspNext` with `cspnext_tiny` at 224), other
architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for details.
